name: Common
description: The trade tongue of humans, the lingua franca of the realms — virtually every traveller speaks it.

name: Common Sign Language
description: A signed language widely used by the Deaf community and by adventurers who need silent communication.

name: Dwarvish
description: The hard, consonant-rich tongue of dwarven clans, written in angular runes.

name: Elvish
description: Fluid and song-like, with a flowing script also used to write Sylvan and Undercommon.

name: Giant
description: The deep tongue of giants and ogres, written in dwarven runes.

name: Gnomish
description: The clever, technical language of gnomes — celebrated for treatises on natural philosophy.

name: Goblin
description: The harsh, guttural language of goblins, hobgoblins, and bugbears.

name: Halfling
description: A warm, rolling language spoken among halflings — rarely written, since halflings prefer oral tradition.

name: Orc
description: The brusque, direct tongue of orcs, written in dwarven runes when written at all.

name: Abyssal
description: The chaotic, barbed tongue of demons and the Abyss.

name: Celestial
description: The lyrical, ringing language of angels and beings of the Upper Planes.

name: Deep Speech
description: The alien tongue of mind flayers and aboleths — twisted, unsettling, with no written form.

name: Draconic
description: The harsh, hissing language of dragons and dragonborn — believed to be the oldest spoken tongue.

name: Druidic
description: The secret tongue of druids, known only to those who follow the Old Faith.

name: Infernal
description: The orderly, sibilant tongue of devils and the Nine Hells — written in arcane symbols of pact-making.

name: Primordial
description: The language of elementals — divided into Aquan, Auran, Ignan, and Terran dialects.

name: Sylvan
description: The melodic language of fey creatures, dryads, and pixies.

name: Thieves' Cant
description: A secret cipher of slang and signs used by criminals; learned by Rogues automatically.

name: Undercommon
description: The trade tongue of the Underdark — a creole of surface and Underdark languages.
